name: Dangerous Nightingale
original_name: でんじゃらすないちんげーる
source:
Mizuki, the younger sister, has to take care of her older brother Kota, who injured both his arms in an accident because his parents are on a business trip.
However, her energetic brother gets horny every time his sister does something to him...
And finally his brother against her sister...

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ133343.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
妹妹水树必须照顾哥哥幸田，哥哥幸田因父母出差而在一次事故中双臂受伤。
然而，每当他的妹妹对他做一些事情时，她精力充沛的哥哥就会变得饥渴……
最后他的兄弟对抗她的妹妹……

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ133343.html]DLsite[/url]]
